text:
Sam: starting thread for Verdant POC - customer wants to run a 13B open model in private VPC, 14-day trial.
Leila: prefer q8 variant to hit cost targets; fp16 fallback for critical flows.
Jun: they require session continuity and SSO. sticky KV-cache across replicas is a must.
Harper: runtime note: q8 on native runtime gives best throughput on A10g; will validate quant profile and run kernel checks.
SecurityBot: checklist: CMK KMS, SAML SSO, syslog over TLS to customer SIEM, export-control questionnaire, and no telemetry leaving the VPC.
BillingBot: POC cost estimate will include 1xA10g reserved block + storage + monitoring; posting estimate after internal approval.
Sam: ops plan draft: 1) provision private pool, 2) push model artifact + quant profile, 3) run warmup + perf suite, 4) run 100-case QA.
Leila: warmup snippet to include in runbook: 
``
./tools/warmup --model verdant-13b-open-q8 --seq 512 --iters 10
```
Jun: blocker: legal signoff needed for customer-managed KMS and finetune NDA.
SecurityBot: need architecture diagram and CIDRs by EOD to pre-approve network flows.
Sam: action items assigned: Jun -> infra request and NAT/egress, Leila -> quant/profile + perf, Harper -> KV-affinity plan, SecurityBot -> send checklist, BillingBot -> publish estimate. Sync with customer tomorrow 10am PT. :rocket:
